description: FLUX.2 [klein] prompt adherence: each prompt's elements as yes/no questions for a local Qwen3-VL judge. Kit's image and the float32 Diffusers reference image share the fixture's prompt, size, steps and initial noise; Kit passes if its positive-question score is no lower than the reference's by more than marginPercentagePoints. Extra seeds run on Kit only, with Kit's own seeded noise, to show seed spread. Each prompt also has one control question whose expected answer is no, to check the judge does not answer yes to everything.
